title: Crestline Fleet Account Mobile Service Visit Fee Disputes
content:
A business on a Crestline Fleet Account that contests the fee of its most recent mobile service visit files a dispute on that visit fee invoice. The rule on visit fee disputes fixes the amount the dispute carries.

## Effect of the filing

Filing contests part of the amount charged on a mobile service visit fee invoice. It registers one new open dispute on that visit fee invoice, carrying the disputed amount given, with the dispute reason recorded as a discount not applied. Nothing on the invoice or on the account balance changes. Afterwards the dispute shows as open on the account's dispute list with its reference number.

## How the filing is made

The tool is `file_fleet_trip_fee_dispute_f6605125`. It is the business's own filing, made in person by the business's authorized fleet contact: the agent unlocks the tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_account_id` | reference number of the business's fleet account, as shown by the fleet account lookup and read out by the agent | identifier text |
| `source_fleet_txn_id` | reference number of the mobile service visit fee invoice being disputed, as shown by the fleet activity lookup and read out by the agent | identifier text |
| `disputed_amount` | the part of the visit fee placed in dispute | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A text rendering of a receipt with these fields: `dispute_id` (reference number of the new dispute), `fleet_account_id` (the account disputed on), `invoice_id` (the visit fee invoice disputed), `reason` (always `discount_not_applied`), `disputed_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, as recorded), `status` (always `open`) and `filed_at` (the moment the dispute was registered). A receipt whose status is `open` means the dispute was registered.
